prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Live Pet Preview: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a two-column layout showing a live desktop preview of the pet on the left alongside selection controls on the right. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s), while users report pets missing or looking wrong.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Pet Recovery Hint: Add clear helper text below sign-in options explaining how logging in restores existing adoption certificates and saved pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Bar & Time Estimate: Display explicit progress percentages and estimated seconds remaining while the app prepares the pet on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step drop-off is high with a mean duration over 38 minutes due to long background rendering without feedback.)
3: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines: Add photo selection guidelines and explicit tips on lighting and contrast directly on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted that custom pet creation fails or results look distorted due to improper photo uploads.)
4: [finish, layout] Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome: Reframe home_intro screen with a spotlight layout featuring shortcut hints and an instant desktop summoning test button. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not show up on the desktop after finishing setup.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop notification alert when pet preparation finishes on the waiting screen so users know when their pet drops onto the desktop. (why: Users wait over 3 minutes on average during pet setup and miss when the pet finally launches on screen.)

scores.note: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (39.1%) and funnel + support both highlight UI preview/quality issues, but requires major layout changes.
Directly addresses the largest support ticket volume (8 emails) with a low-cost copy/hint modification on sign_in.
Addresses massive mean delay (38+ min) on home step by adding visual feedback for background processing.
Simple copy/guideline fix on the highest drop-off step (adoption), supported by 3 user complaints.
Targets finish step (35.2% drop-off), but requires layout refactoring to resolve post-setup confusion.
Helps re-engage users stuck in long background processing on home, though evidence is mostly funnel-based.
